audit_log_actor_check.name: audit_log_actor_check
audit_log_actor_check.value: "audit_log"."actor" GLOB 'user:?*' OR "audit_log"."actor" GLOB 'token:?*' OR "audit_log"."actor" GLOB 'sync:?*' OR "audit_log"."actor" GLOB 'system:?*'

device_authorizations_approval_names_pri.name: device_authorizations_approval_names_principal
device_authorizations_approval_names_pri.value:
("device_authorizations"."decision" IS NULL AND "device_authorizations"."decided_at" IS NULL AND "device_authorizations"."principal" IS NULL AND "device_authorizations"."generation" = 0 AND "device_authorizations"."consumed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("device_authorizations"."decision" IS NOT NULL AND "device_authorizations"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND (
          ("device_authorizations"."decision" = 'denied' AND "device_authorizations"."principal" IS NULL AND "device_authorizations"."generation" = 0 AND "device_authorizations"."consumed_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("device_authorizations"."decision" = 'approved' AND "device_authorizations"."principal" IS NOT NULL AND "device_authorizations"."principal" LIKE 'user:%')
        ))

environments_slug_check.name: environments_slug_check
environments_slug_check.value: (length("environments"."slug") BETWEEN 1 AND 63 AND "environments"."slug" GLOB '[a-z0-9]*' AND "environments"."slug" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*') OR (instr("environments"."slug", '~') BETWEEN 2 AND 64 AND substr("environments"."slug", 1, instr("environments"."slug", '~') - 1) GLOB '[a-z0-9]*' AND substr("environments"."slug", 1, instr("environments"."slug", '~') - 1) NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*' AND length(substr("environments"."slug", instr("environments"."slug", '~') + 1)) BETWEEN 1 AND 40 AND substr("environments"."slug", instr("environments"."slug", '~') + 1) NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*')

generated.as: (CASE WHEN revoked_at IS NULL THEN subject END)

identities_provider_check.name: identities_provider_check
identities_provider_check.value: length("identities"."provider") BETWEEN 1 AND 32 AND "identities"."provider" GLOB '[a-z0-9]*' AND "identities"."provider" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*'

project_folders_folder_check.name: project_folders_folder_check
project_folders_folder_check.value: "project_folders"."folder" IS NULL OR (length("project_folders"."folder") BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND "project_folders"."folder" NOT GLOB '*/*' AND "project_folders"."folder" = trim("project_folders"."folder"))

projects_slug_check.name: projects_slug_check
projects_slug_check.value: (length("projects"."slug") BETWEEN 1 AND 63 AND "projects"."slug" GLOB '[a-z0-9]*' AND "projects"."slug" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*') OR (instr("projects"."slug", '~') BETWEEN 2 AND 64 AND substr("projects"."slug", 1, instr("projects"."slug", '~') - 1) GLOB '[a-z0-9]*' AND substr("projects"."slug", 1, instr("projects"."slug", '~') - 1) NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*' AND length(substr("projects"."slug", instr("projects"."slug", '~') + 1)) BETWEEN 1 AND 40 AND substr("projects"."slug", instr("projects"."slug", '~') + 1) NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*')

secret_folders_folder_check.name: secret_folders_folder_check
secret_folders_folder_check.value: "secret_folders"."folder" IS NULL OR (length("secret_folders"."folder") BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND "secret_folders"."folder" NOT GLOB '*/*' AND "secret_folders"."folder" = trim("secret_folders"."folder"))

secrets_key_check.name: secrets_key_check
secrets_key_check.value: length("secrets"."key") BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND "secrets"."key" GLOB '[A-Za-z_]*' AND "secrets"."key" NOT GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9_]*'

vault_grants_on_every_project.name: vault_grants_on_every_project
vault_grants_on_every_project.where: "vault_grants"."project_id" IS NULL AND "vault_grants"."environment_id" IS NULL AND "vault_grants"."environment_slug" IS NULL

vault_grants_one_place.name: vault_grants_one_place
vault_grants_one_place.value: (("vault_grants"."project_id" IS NULL) <> ("vault_grants"."environment_id" IS NULL) AND "vault_grants"."environment_slug" IS NULL) OR ("vault_grants"."project_id" IS NULL AND "vault_grants"."environment_id" IS NULL)

vault_grants_environment_slug_check.name: vault_grants_environment_slug_check
vault_grants_environment_slug_check.value: "vault_grants"."environment_slug" IS NULL OR (length("vault_grants"."environment_slug") BETWEEN 1 AND 63 AND "vault_grants"."environment_slug" GLOB '[a-z0-9]*' AND "vault_grants"."environment_slug" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*')

vault_grants_environment_role_check.name: vault_grants_environment_role_check
vault_grants_environment_role_check.value: ("vault_grants"."environment_id" IS NULL AND "vault_grants"."environment_slug" IS NULL) OR "vault_grants"."role" IN ('viewer', 'developer', 'auditor')

vault_members_principal_check.name: vault_members_principal_check
vault_members_principal_check.value:
("vault_members"."principal" GLOB 'user:?*' OR "vault_members"."principal" GLOB 'token:?*' OR "vault_members"."principal" GLOB 'sync:?*')
        AND substr("vault_members"."principal", instr("vault_members"."principal", ':') + 1, 1) <> ':'
        AND instr("vault_members"."principal", ' ') = 0 AND instr("vault_members"."principal", char(9)) = 0
        AND instr("vault_members"."principal", char(10)) = 0 AND instr("vault_members"."principal", char(13)) = 0
